environment.description: Flask application deployed on an EC2 instance behind an Application Load Balancer with default settings. The ALB forwards all traffic on port 443 to the target group on port 8080. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional request filtering or inspection is configured on the ALB. The application runs as a Docker container with the python:3.11-slim base image. Database file is stored on an EBS volume mounted at /var/data/.

config.network: ALB -> Target Group (port 8080), SG allows 443 inbound from 0.0.0.0/0
config.alb_config: Default listener rules, no WAF association, access logging to S3
